entities.name: Mária Bartuszová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mária Bartuszová was a Slovak sculptor known for her abstract white plaster sculptures. Her work is included in the Centre Pompidou in Paris, the Slovak National Gallery in Bratislava and the Tate in London. Her artwork is part of curated selection of Venice Biennale titled "Milk of Dreams", Arsenale Area
